settings.pagerank: forward/reverse unweighted scores, alpha=0.85; log(genes * score)
settings.pagerank_rank: top-first rank per column, ties averaged, scaled to [0,1]
settings.neighbours: training-fold CEGv2 neighbour share; no held-out labels
settings.weights: incoming/outgoing mean, SD, absolute mean and positive share
settings.scope: combined 15 public networks; variants fixed before this run; no personalised PageRank
